name: GrainIntakeWeighbridgeConsole
tagline: Truck queue, sample grading, dockage and shrink, bin allocation and weighbridge tickets – one drop-in app.
description: A complete harvest receival app for co-ops, elevators and grain traders: follow every truck from the gate to the silo, grade samples against built-in receival standards, calculate dockage, drying shrink and payable weight, allocate bins with segregation and capacity checks, track contract deliveries and print weighbridge tickets. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Six-stage queue board with drag and drop and stage buttons
Built-in receival standards for wheat, barley, canola, maize and sorghum
Dockage, moisture shrink and handling loss with payable net
Bin allocation with grade segregation and capacity checks, bin suggestions
Contract delivery progress and over-delivery warnings
Bulk allocate bins and weigh out with undo
Shift KPIs as Power Fx outputs
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts; keyboard and screen-reader support
controlType: standard (2 controls: dataset + Power Pages field control)
